independentReview.status: Internal reviews of the public run-spaceapp 1.1.5 tree (oll4com/spaceapp 8a3e1f0, the release commit; npm next 1.1.5), each given the byte-for-byte source archive and the snapshot README with the neutral prompt of review-pack.md. Neither reviewer had network access for npm ci.

reviews.note: Main findings: docs/quality/baseline.json names an older source commit; no live provider proofs; first-party images pulled by tag (third-party pinned); observability and off-host backup gaps; readiness timeouts not cancelled; domain-boundaries.md says npm test runs test:architecture (only check does).

Confirmed defect: WebSocket handshakes (VNC stream, shared chat) skipped the same-site Origin check; fixed on dev dbb253756e for 1.1.6. Also reported: child-process env scrubbing incomplete, SEC-009 mkdir from request path, CORE-011 rollback pattern at other sites, a 0057 migration collision in the public tree, provenance check skips files outside the manifest, factory-reset ignores backup failure, stale install locks, no isolation between agents in the CLI container. These still need verification and go to the 1.1.6 plan.
